verdict.rationale: Working Copy documents its own 'Link external directory' feature. It lets a repository be backed by a folder or Document Package picked through the Files app, which covers other apps' storage. It also documents dragging files in from other apps, and other apps can reach its repositories through the document picker. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of linked external directories, documentation of how far this works across different apps' sandboxes and file providers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can access and work with files and repositories from other apps' sandboxes on my device

citations.quote: When adding repositories you tap Link external directory and pick a folder or Document Package in the Files app.
Drag files from your emails, the Files app or any other supporting app to add to your repositories.
All repositories in Working Copy can be accessed in the Files app and 3rd party applications using the document picker or file browser components.
